title: Tulle Sequin Sleeveless A-Line Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Float into elegance with this tulle sleeveless A-line evening dress! Featuring a dreamy silhouette, delicate layers of soft tulle, and a flattering sleeveless design, this gown is perfect for making a graceful statement at any formal event or special occasion.


Tips: Highly elastic fabric; stretches at least 2 inches.
Select based primarily on chest measurement.
Choose a smaller size for a snug fit.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
